description: This file defines the ValidationException class, which extends InvalidArgumentException. It is used within the OrangeHRM Core API v2 validation module to represent validation-related errors, carrying additional context such as the input that caused the error and the validation rule that was violated.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for validation errors, encapsulating the input data and the violated validation rule.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ValidationException with input data, a validation rule, and an optional message.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input data related to the validation error.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data related to the validation error.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Returns the validation rule associated with the error.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Sets the validation rule associated with the error.
